title: Faster
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Monday. The strip is drawn in ten strokes. The beach, the coat, the dog, the wind. Wood times it: forty seconds. He looks at it. It's the best drawing of the coat. He's angry about that for a panel and then he isn't.

panels.composition: The beach, December wind. WOOD in the coat, collar up, from behind. BARNABY leaning into the wind. Ten strokes.

image.prompt: a windy December beach with a man in a chore coat from behind and a small dog leaning into the wind, drawn in ten strokes, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The pad. The drawing. Forty seconds. Wood's watch drawn as a circle.

image.prompt: close on a drawing pad with a ten-stroke drawing of a beach and a wristwatch drawn as a blank circle, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood's face. Angry at the drawing for being good.

image.prompt: a young man's face angry at his own drawing, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The beach. The same ten strokes. Wood walking on. The anger gone. The strip keeps the ten strokes. Winter's line.

image.prompt: the same windy beach with a man in a chore coat and a dog walking on, drawn in ten strokes, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)

notes: Ten strokes, forty seconds, the best one. Winter's line.
